| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages/:userMessageId/retry` — regenerates the response without duplicating the user's question; it supports "partial message visible with a failure indication, and a way to try again" in RF04 | RF04 | Voyage AI (embedding, reused from cache) + Claude Sonnet 5 (response) |
| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/insight` | RF08 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |
| `POST /entries` — called from the "save to journal" button (see 6.2) | RF10 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (PII) + Voyage AI (embedding) |

### 6.4 Search
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /entries/search?q=&source=&dateFrom=&dateTo=&limit=` — no `category` (see RF06) | RF06 | Voyage AI (query embedding) |

### 6.5 Export
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /export/summary` — asynchronous job | RF05 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |
| `GET /export/:jobId/status` | RF05 | — |
| `GET /export/:jobId/download` | RF05 | — |

### 6.6 Dashboard
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /dashboard/aggregate?period=` — separate from the text so it does not block the chart | RF09 | — |
| `GET /dashboard/narrative?period=` | RF09 | Claude Haiku 4.5 |

### 6.7 Account
| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
|---|---|---|
| `PATCH /account/settings` — includes the persona toggle (extension) | RNF05, extension | — |
| `DELETE /account` | RNF05 | — |

---

## 7. Integrated flowchart — screens × requirements × backend

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph T0["Screen 0 — Splash"]
        direction TB
        E01["GET /auth/session"]
    end

    subgraph T01["Screen 0.1 — Authentication vault · RF03"]
        direction TB
        E02b["Face ID / Touch ID / PIN — validated on the device, no backend call"]
        E02["POST /auth/login (if the session has fully expired)"]
    end

    subgraph T1["Screen 1 — Home (chat) · RF04, RF08, RF10"]
        direction TB
        E04["POST /chat/sessions"]
        E05["GET /chat/sessions/:id/messages"]
        E06["POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages"]
        E06b["POST .../messages/:userMessageId/retry"]
        E07["POST /chat/sessions/:id/insight"]
        E07b["POST /entries (save message)"]
    end

    subgraph T2["Screen 2 — Insertion modal · RF01, RF02"]
        direction TB
        E08["POST /media/ocr"]
        E09["POST /entries"]
    end

    subgraph T3["Screen 3 — Side menu"]
        direction TB
        E10["GET /chat/sessions"]
        E10b["'Novo Chat' button — opens T1 empty, backed by E04"]
    end

    subgraph T4["Screen 4 — My records · RF05, RF06, RF07"]
        direction TB
        E11["GET /entries (source/dateFrom/dateTo — no category)"]
        E12["GET /entries/search"]
        E15["POST /export/summary"]
        E15b["GET /export/:jobId/status"]
        E16["GET /export/:jobId/download"]
    end

    subgraph T5["Screen 5 — Action plans (extension)"]
        direction TB
        E17["No calls — static"]
    end

    subgraph T6["Screen 6 — Settings · RF09, RNF05"]
        direction TB
        E18["GET /dashboard/aggregate"]
        E19["GET /dashboard/narrative"]
        E20["PATCH /account/settings"]
        E21["DELETE /account"]
        E22["POST /auth/logout"]
    end

    T0 --> T01 --> T1
    T1 --> T2
    T1 --> T3
    T3 -->|Novo Chat| T1
    T3 --> T4
    T3 --> T5
    T3 --> T6

    style T5 fill:#FAEEDA,stroke:#BA7517,color:#412402
```

*(The amber "Action plans" subgraph marks the only screen with no backend calls — a product extension.)*

---

## 8. Data model (reference)

Main entities of the backend (Supabase / Postgres). Field names are reference suggestions, not mandatory character by character. **Where this table differs from the API contract (`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`), the contract prevails** (see section 6).

| Table | Main fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `users` | id, email, biometric_enabled, persona, created_at | RLS: a user accesses only their own row |
| `entries` | id, user_id, content, source (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`), chat_message_id (nullable), embedding (vector, see 9), sync_status, created_at, updated_at | `embedding` generated in `POST /entries` via Voyage AI |
| `tags` | id, user_id, name | Extension — created manually by the user |
| `entry_tags` | entry_id, tag_id | N:N join table |
| `chat_sessions` | id, user_id, title, created_at | — |
| `chat_messages` | id, session_id, role (`user`/`assistant`), content, created_at | User messages show the RF10 button |
| `export_jobs` | id, user_id, status (`pending`/`processing`/`done`/`error`), period_start, period_end, file_url, created_at | Asynchronous — see 6.5 |

**RLS pattern (every table with `user_id`):** policy `auth.uid() = user_id`, no exceptions.

---

## 9. Technology stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Mobile app | Flutter, BLoC, Clean Architecture |
| Backend | Already built and frozen; consumed through its API |
| Infrastructure | Supabase (Postgres + pgvector + Storage + Auth + RLS) |
| Chat / vision / OCR / summary / insights / dashboard / PII | Claude Sonnet 5 (chat) + Claude Haiku 4.5 (the rest) — in the backend |
| Embeddings (RAG) | Voyage AI `voyage-4` — in the backend |
| Speech-to-text (audio transcription) | Whisper on-device (`whisper_ggml`); audio never reaches the backend |
| Error handling | `fpdart` (`Either<Failure, T>`) |
| Layer rule | RNF06 |
| Test coverage | RNF07 |

---

## 10. Configuration parameters

Fixed values — not to be reinterpreted.

| Parameter | Value | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Background session timeout | 5 min | RF03 |
| Search debounce | 300 ms | RF06 |
| Proactive insight trigger | 5 messages OR 2 min of inactivity | RF08 |
| Dashboard rendering scenarios | 0 / 1 / > 30 entries | RF09 |
| Minimum test coverage (domain) | ≥ 80% | RNF07 |
| Local UI latency | < 100 ms | RNF01 |
| Loading-indicator threshold | > 300 ms | RNF01 |
| Network-error scenarios tested | 5 endpoints × 3 failures = 15 | RNF09 |

---

## 11. Error codes (RNF09)

Every endpoint returns `{ code, message, retryable }`. Minimum codes the app handles:

| Code | Situation | `retryable` |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | Session expired, re-authentication needed | no |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | Invalid credentials / biometrics | no |
| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | Request exceeded the time limit | yes |
| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | No connection — action blocked (see RF04/RF06) | yes |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed request body | no |
| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | PII check failed before persisting | yes |
| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | Voyage AI unavailable / error | yes |
| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | Claude did not respond in time (chat/insight/summary/dashboard) | yes |
| `NOT_FOUND` | Resource does not exist or does not belong to the user | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Request limit exceeded | yes |

The complete, closed list of the backend's 13 codes, with HTTP statuses, is in `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md`.

---

## 12. Delivery order

Work is delivered in units, one per functional requirement, preceded by a foundation unit, in this order:

**F000 → RF03 → RF01 → RF02 → RF07 → RF06 → RF04 → RF10 → RF08 → RF05 → RF09**

- **F000 (foundation)** covers what no single requirement owns but all of them use: project scaffold, `design_tokens.dart`, HTTP client returning `Either`, login and sign-up (Screen 0.1a in the prototype), base navigation and expired-session handling.
- RF10 comes after RF01 and RF04; RF08 comes after RF04.

---

## 13. Technical constraints

**Fixed:**
- Flutter and Dart at the version pinned for the repository (fvm).
- State management: `flutter_bloc`.
- Clean Architecture, three layers per feature.
- Error handling: `fpdart`; repositories return `Either<Failure, T>`.
- Test doubles: `mocktail`.
- On-device speech-to-text: `whisper_ggml`.
- Visual tokens: `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` is the single source of colors, typography, spacing and radii.
- Platform: iOS, portrait only.
- Folder convention:

```
lib/
  core/
  features/
    <feature>/
      data/
      domain/
      presentation/
```

**Free (choose what fits):** routing, HTTP client, local cache, dependency injection, secure storage, biometrics package, chart package.

1	# Implementation Plan: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)
2	
3	**Branch**: `005-multi-source-timeline` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec.md header)
4	
5	**Date**: 2026-10-17 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
6	
7	**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/005-multi-source-timeline/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
8	§1 (RF07), §6.1/§6.2 (`/auth/session`, `/auth/refresh`, `/entries`, `/entries/:id`), §8 (data model), §9, §13;
9	`docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`; `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/entries/{id}`
10	schemas; `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §§2.4, 3, 4, 6; and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.
11	Depends on F000 (`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`), both already
12	implemented — this is the first unit to make the already-built `SessionBloc`/overlay machinery and
13	`EntriesRepository`/`cachedEntries` seam actually earn their keep from outside `session/`/`capture/`.
14	
15	## Summary
16	
17	"Meus Registros" fetches and displays every one of the signed-in user's journal entries — manual, audio,
18	photo, and (origin-agnostically) chat — in one reverse-chronological, date-grouped, infinitely-scrolling

small, genuinely new cross-feature wire (the `reauthRequired` one-shot stream into the page, research.md R5)
rather than touching `session/`'s already-built, already-correct machinery at all.

*No entries — this unit adds no new dependency and no new feature folder (reuses `records/`); its one
cross-cutting concern (reaching the existing session-expired overlay without bloc-to-bloc coupling) is solved
with a one-shot stream pattern already proven in this codebase (`InsertionModalBloc.closeRequests`), not a
new kind of architectural seam.*

## Post-Design Constitution Check

Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):

- `RecordsBloc` and every `records/domain/` file were re-checked against their actual planned imports:
  `fpdart`, `equatable`, `core/network/failure.dart`, `entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`,

  already has), never a `data/`-to-`data/` or `data/`-to-`presentation/` one — no violation.
- The one place `SessionBloc` is imported outside `session/` (`records_page.dart`) was re-checked against
  requirements.md RF07's literal wording ("No BLoC imports another BLoC directly") — `RecordsPage` is a
  `State<StatefulWidget>`, not a `Bloc` subclass, so this holds literally, not just in spirit. This mirrors
  `main.dart`'s and `session_expired_overlay.dart`'s own existing, already-shipped pattern of a *widget*
  (never a bloc) being the thing that reads one feature's bloc stream and dispatches into another's.
- Re-checked R7's "no call site for `getById()`" conclusion against `requirements.md` §9 ("Entries are
  immutable: there is no `PATCH /entries/:id` or `DELETE /entries/:id`") and found it still holds: nothing in
  this design ever produces a locally-pending/failed write for an entry this unit can display, so no
  reconciliation trigger exists to wire up — confirmed not an oversight, documented as a deliberate, narrow
  scope boundary. This resolves spec.md Clarification 2's own illustrative example ("after the Sessão
  expirada overlay is dismissed and the session is renewed") as a description of `getById()`'s intended
  future purpose, not a call site this unit implements.
- No change surfaces that touches `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, any native iOS project file,
  or any AI provider — Principle III remains intact.

No new violations. Gate remains PASS.

# Cerne backend — documentation package

The backend is already built and frozen. This package documents what the app needs to consume it. The backend source code is not part of it.

## Contents

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `api/openapi.yaml` | API contract of the 23 endpoints — the source of truth |
| `error-taxonomy.md` | The 13 error codes, with HTTP status and `retryable` |
| `export-screen-states.md` | Mapping between the export screen states and the export job statuses (RF05) |
| `sync-badge.md` | Semantics of the per-entry synchronization badge |
| `known-bugs.md` | Known non-blocking backend defects, with workarounds |
| `fixtures/` | Test media (audio, images for OCR), the expected transcription of the audio, and the three seeded entries used by semantic search |

Credentials (project URL and keys) are not in this package: they are provided in the app's `.env`.

## Contract path → function

`api/openapi.yaml` has no router: each operation is served by its own Edge Function at `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>` (see `servers` and each operation's `x-cerne-function` in the YAML) — **never** directly at the REST path below. Path parameters are appended as the final URL segments, in the same order as they appear in the path; any literal segment after the last parameter (e.g., the `/retry` of `chat.messages.retry`) does not exist in the real URL.

| Contract path | Function (`{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>`) |
|---|---|
| `POST /auth/signup` | `auth-signup` |
| `POST /auth/login` | `auth-login` |
| `POST /auth/refresh` | `auth-refresh` |
| `GET /auth/session` | `auth-session` |

| `POST /media/ocr` | `media-ocr` |
| `POST /chat/sessions` | `chat-sessions-create` |
| `GET /chat/sessions` | `chat-sessions-list` |

| `POST /chat/sessions/{id}/messages` | `chat-messages-send` |
| `POST /chat/sessions/{id}/messages/{userMessageId}/retry` | `chat-messages-retry` |
| `POST /chat/sessions/{id}/insight` | `chat-insight-create` |
| `POST /export/summary` | `export-summary-create` |
| `GET /export/{jobId}/status` | `export-status-get` |

3	Every endpoint returns errors as `{ code, message, retryable }`. The list below is closed: no other code exists.
4	
5	| Code | HTTP | Retryable |
6	|---|---|---|
7	| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
8	| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
9	| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
10	| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | _(no HTTP response — see note)_ | yes |
11	| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
12	| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
13	| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
14	| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
15	| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
16	| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
17	| `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
18	| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
19	| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |
20	
21	**Two deliberate design choices (these never happen in this API):**
22	- **Never `403`** — a resource belonging to another user always answers `404 NOT_FOUND` (so its existence is not revealed).

24

file.content:
# Error taxonomy — 13 codes

Every endpoint returns errors as `{ code, message, retryable }`. The list below is closed: no other code exists.

| Code | HTTP | Retryable |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | _(no HTTP response — see note)_ | yes |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
| `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |

**Two deliberate design choices (these never happen in this API):**
- **Never `403`** — a resource belonging to another user always answers `404 NOT_FOUND` (so its existence is not revealed).
- **Never `409`** — the idempotency of RF10 (re-sending the same chat message as an entry) always answers `200`; there is no "conflict" code.

**`NETWORK_OFFLINE` has no HTTP status:** it is the only code that never becomes an actual response — it represents a connection that ends without any response.

1	# Data Model: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)
2	
3	Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1 (RF07), 6.2, 8, 13; `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`;
4	`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` (list) and `/entries/{id}` schemas;
5	`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §§2.4, 3, 6. This unit extends the `entries` feature's shared
6	`Entry`/`EntriesRepository` (RF01) with two new read methods, and adds one new feature folder's worth of
7	domain helpers and presentation (`records/`, R8) — it introduces no new backend-shaped entity beyond widening
8	one existing enum (R2).
9	
10	## `Entry` (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`) — extended, not replaced
11	
12	Every field RF01 already modeled (`id`, `content`, `source`, `chatMessageId`, `occurredAt`, `tags`,
13	`piiStatus`, `piiSpans`, `embeddingStatus`, `mediaDurationSeconds`, `serverRevision`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`)
14	is unchanged in shape — this unit reads `serverRevision`/`updatedAt` (sync-badge.md's two fields) and `tags`
15	(read-only chips), which RF01 already carries but never renders. One change:
16	
17	```dart
18	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }   // chat added (research.md R2)
19	```
20	
21	## `EntriesPage` (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entries_page.dart`) — NEW
22	
23	The shape of one `GET /entries` response, minus the fields this unit never uses (`meta.total`, and every
24	`source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` filter parameter — reserved for RF06).
25	
26	| Field | Type | Notes |
27	|---|---|---|
28	| `entries` | `List<Entry>` | `data`, in the order the backend returns it (newest-occurred-first, per the resolved ordering Clarification). |
29	| `nextCursor` | `String?` | `meta.nextCursor` verbatim; `null` means this was the last page. |
30	
31	```dart
32	class EntriesPage extends Equatable {
33	  const EntriesPage({required this.entries, required this.nextCursor});
34	  final List<Entry> entries;
35	  final String? nextCursor;
36	}
37	```
38	
39	## `EntriesRepository` — extended (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)
40	
41	```dart
42	abstract class EntriesRepository {
43	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source}); // unchanged (RF01)
44	  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;                                                                   // unchanged (RF01)
45	  Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor});                                      // NEW
46	  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id);                                                // NEW
47	}
48	```
49	
50	- **`list`** → `GET /entries` (`entries-list`), query parameters `cursor` (when non-null) only — no `limit`
51	  override (backend default 20), no `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` (filters are RF06's).
52	- **`getById`** → `GET /entries/:id` (`entries-get`), `pathSegments: [id]`. Implemented and tested; no call
53	  site in this unit's UI flow (research.md R7).
54	- Both retry exactly once through `SessionRepository.refresh()` on `AuthExpiredFailure` before giving up
55	  (research.md R4) — see `contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` for the exact sequence. `create()` is
56	  untouched.
57	
58	### `EntriesRemoteDataSource` — extended (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source.dart`)
59	
60	Adds `list({String? cursor})` and `getById(String id)`, both parsing responses through the *same* private
61	`_parseEntry` the existing `create()` already uses (made reusable across a single object and a list of
62	objects) — no duplicated parsing logic. `list()` additionally parses `meta.nextCursor`.
63	
64	### `EntriesRepositoryImpl` — extended (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart`)
65	
66	Gains one new constructor dependency: `SessionRepository` (`session/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`
67	— a cross-feature *domain* interface, the same shape `SessionRepositoryImpl` already depends on `auth`'s
68	`Account`). `cachedEntries`/`create()` behavior is unchanged.
69	
70	## `ApiClient` — extended (`lib/core/network/api_client.dart`)
71	
72	```dart
73	Future<Either<Failure, Map<String, dynamic>>> call(
74	  String function, {
75	  required String method,
76	  Map<String, dynamic>? body,
77	  List<String>? pathSegments,
78	  Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,   // NEW (research.md R1)
79	  AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession,
80	})
81	```
82	
83	`queryParameters` is passed straight through to `Dio.request()`. Every existing call site (`entries-create`,
84	`auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) is unaffected — the parameter defaults to omitted.
85	
86	## `SyncBadgeState` / `LocalWriteOutcome` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart`) — NEW
87	
88	```dart
89	enum SyncBadgeState { synchronized, synchronizing, error }
90	enum LocalWriteOutcome { pending, failed }
91	
92	class SyncBadge {
93	  const SyncBadge._();
94	  static SyncBadgeState derive(LocalWriteOutcome? localWrite) => switch (localWrite) {
95	    null => SyncBadgeState.synchronized,
96	    LocalWriteOutcome.pending => SyncBadgeState.synchronizing,
97	    LocalWriteOutcome.failed => SyncBadgeState.error,
98	  };
99	}
100	```
101	
102	A pure, total function over `sync-badge.md`'s model (research.md R6). `RecordsBloc` calls it with
103	`localWrite: null` for every entry it ever renders — both of its entry sources (`EntriesRepository.list()`'s
104	results, `.cachedEntries`) are, by construction, already server-confirmed. Never depends on session/auth state
105	(FR-005), by having no session-related input at all.
106	
107	**Mapping to the prototype's sync badge** (`prototype-extract.md` §3/§6 — reuses existing `DesignTokens`
108	verbatim, no new token):
109	
110	| `SyncBadgeState` | Dot color | Label |
111	|---|---|---|
112	| `synchronized` | `DesignTokens.colorSuccess` (`#4C6B4F`) | "sincronizado" |
113	| `synchronizing` | `DesignTokens.colorWarningSync` (`#C98A3E`) | "sincronizando" |
114	| `error` | `DesignTokens.colorError` (`#B3402A`) | "erro de sync" |
115	
116	## `DateGroup` / `DateGrouper` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/date_group.dart`) — NEW
117	
118	Maps spec.md's "Entry Timeline Page" grouping requirement (FR-002) to a pure function, independent of widget
119	code so it's directly unit-testable (RNF07).
120	
121	```dart
122	class DateGroup extends Equatable {
123	  const DateGroup({required this.label, required this.entries});
124	  final String label;            // "Hoje" | "Ontem" | "{day} de {monthName}" (research.md R9)
125	  final List<Entry> entries;     // newest-to-oldest by occurredAt (resolved ordering Clarification)
126	}
127	
128	class DateGrouper {
129	  const DateGrouper._();
130	  static List<DateGroup> group(List<Entry> entries, {DateTime? now});
131	}
132	```
133	
134	- Input `entries` is assumed already sorted newest-to-oldest (see `EntryMerger` below, which guarantees this
135	  for `RecordsBloc`'s own data) — `group()` only buckets, it never re-sorts within or across groups.
136	  Groups themselves come out newest-to-oldest because the input is.
137	- Bucketing compares each entry's `occurredAt.toLocal()` calendar day against `(now ?? DateTime.now()).toLocal()`'s —
138	  the device's local calendar day (spec.md Assumptions), not UTC.
139	- `now` is an optional override purely for deterministic unit tests ("today" fixed at a known instant); production call sites omit it.
140	
141	## `EntryMerger` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger.dart`) — NEW
142	
143	Implements spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 (dedupe-by-ID, preferring the fresher copy).
144	
145	```dart
146	class EntryMerger {
147	  const EntryMerger._();
148	  static List<Entry> merge({required List<Entry> primary, required List<Entry> secondary}) {
149	    // union by id, primary's copy wins on a shared id, result sorted newest-to-oldest by occurredAt
150	  }
151	}
152	```
153	
154	`RecordsBloc` calls `EntryMerger.merge(primary: <freshly fetched or already-displayed entries>, secondary:
155	entriesRepository.cachedEntries)` every time it has a new batch to show (research.md R3) — never inside
156	`EntriesRepositoryImpl`.
157	
158	## `RecordsEvent` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_event.dart`) — NEW
159	
160	| Event | When |
161	|---|---|
162	| `RecordsStarted` | `RecordsPage.initState` — triggers the first page fetch. |
163	| `NextPageRequested` | The list's `ScrollController` crosses a near-bottom threshold, and `!hasReachedEnd && !isLoadingMore`. |
164	| `PageLoadRetried` | The user taps "Tentar novamente" on a failed first load (`RecordsLoadFailure`) or a failed further-page load (`RecordsLoaded.pageLoadFailure`). |
165	| `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` | `RecordsPage`, once the insertion-modal `showModalBottomSheet` future resolves (research.md R10) — re-merges `cachedEntries` into the currently displayed list, no network call. |
166	
167	## `RecordsState` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_state.dart`) — NEW
168	
169	Maps spec.md's "Entry Timeline Page" key entity directly to this sealed state's `RecordsLoaded` fields
170	(entries fetched so far + the cursor to continue from) — no separate domain class for it (research.md-style
171	reasonable decision: nothing else needs this shape outside the bloc that owns it).
172	
173	```dart
174	sealed class RecordsState {}
175	
176	class RecordsLoading extends RecordsState {}
177	
178	class RecordsLoadFailure extends RecordsState {
179	  const RecordsLoadFailure(this.failure);
180	  final Failure failure;   // any failure type, including AuthExpiredFailure (research.md — see below)
181	}
182	
183	class RecordsLoaded extends RecordsState {
184	  const RecordsLoaded({
185	    required this.entries,        // merged + deduped, newest-to-oldest
186	    required this.nextCursor,
187	    required this.isLoadingMore,
188	    this.pageLoadFailure,         // a further-page fetch failed; entries above stay intact, retryable
189	  });
190	  final List<Entry> entries;
191	  final String? nextCursor;
192	  final bool isLoadingMore;
193	  final Failure? pageLoadFailure;
194	
195	  bool get hasReachedEnd => nextCursor == null;
196	  bool get isEmpty => entries.isEmpty;   // RecordsPage renders "Vazio" for this, never a separate event
197	}
198	```
199	
200	- **First-load failure, any cause (including `AuthExpiredFailure`)** → `RecordsLoadFailure` — never the empty
201	  state, so a true zero-entries account is never confused with "couldn't load" (research.md's reasoning under
202	  R5/R7). The one-shot `reauthRequired` stream (next section) still fires in the `AuthExpiredFailure` case, on
203	  top of this state — the overlay appears over the retryable error screen.
204	- **Further-page failure, `AuthExpiredFailure`** → `entries`/`nextCursor` are left exactly as they were,
205	  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false` (so the next scroll-near-bottom re-attempts the same, unconsumed cursor);
206	  `pageLoadFailure` is **not** set for this case — only the one-shot stream fires. This is what makes FR-007's
207	  "without discarding the entries already loaded or the current scroll position... restored exactly as it
208	  was" true by construction (nothing in `RecordsState` changed).
209	- **Further-page failure, any other cause** (timeout, offline, validation, ...) → `pageLoadFailure` set,
210	  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false`, entries unchanged — a retryable inline banner at the bottom of the list
211	  (FR-009/Edge Cases).
212	
213	## `RecordsBloc` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_bloc.dart`) — NEW
214	
215	```dart
216	class RecordsBloc extends Bloc<RecordsEvent, RecordsState> {
217	  RecordsBloc({required EntriesRepository entriesRepository});
218	
219	  Stream<void> get reauthRequired;   // one-shot (research.md R5) — fired on a post-retry AuthExpiredFailure
220	}
221	```
222	
223	Depends only on `EntriesRepository` (never `SessionRepository`, never `ConnectivityChecker` — research.md
224	R4/R11) — the one domain-layer dependency this bloc needs. Never imports `SessionBloc` or any of its
225	event/state types (requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion).
226	
227	## Widgets (`lib/features/records/presentation/widgets/`, `pages/records_page.dart`) — NEW
228	
229	Not separately contracted (pure prototype-fidelity rendering, no new state/logic beyond what's above):
230	
231	- `records_page.dart` — `Scaffold` with the prototype's header (back arrow, title, inert download icon —
232	  FR-008), inert search bar + funnel button (FR-008), a `ListView` driven by `RecordsLoaded.entries` grouped
233	  through `DateGrouper`, a `ScrollController` that survives `BlocBuilder` rebuilds (never recreated, so scroll
234	  position is never lost — FR-003/FR-007), and the `reauthRequired` subscription (research.md R5).
235	- `record_card.dart` — one entry: spine + icon colored by `source` (table below), monospace time
236	  (`occurredAt.toLocal()`, `HH:mm`), `SyncBadgeDot` (table above), text excerpt (`content`, no truncation logic
237	  beyond what the card's fixed layout naturally clips), tag chips (`EntryTag.name`, only when `tags.isNotEmpty`
238	  — FR-002/Acceptance Scenario 2).
239	- `records_empty_state.dart` — notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", "Criar primeiro registro" button
240	  calling the shared `openInsertionModal()` (research.md R10).
241	- `sync_badge_dot.dart` — the 8px dot + mono label pair, parameterized by `SyncBadgeState`.
242	
243	**Origin marker mapping** (`prototype-extract.md`'s `sourceMeta`, verbatim hex — reuses existing `DesignTokens`,
244	no new color token; Phosphor icon names mapped to this app's existing Material-icon convention, same mapping
245	style RF01/RF02 already used for their own icons):
246	
247	| `EntrySource` | Spine/icon color | Material icon (Phosphor equivalent) |
248	|---|---|---|
249	| `manual` | `DesignTokens.colorPrimary` (`#1F3D34`) | `Icons.edit_outlined` (`ph-pencil-simple`) |
250	| `audio` | `DesignTokens.colorSecondary` (`#7C8B6F`) | `Icons.mic_none` (`ph-microphone`) |
251	| `photo` | `DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary` (`#6B6255`) | `Icons.image_outlined` (`ph-image`) |
252	| `chat` | `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (`#C98A3E`) | `Icons.chat_bubble_outline` (`ph-chat-circle-text`) |
253	
254	## Routing / DI changes
255	
256	- `lib/core/routing/app_router.dart`: `AppRoutes.records`'s builder wraps `RecordsPage` in
257	  `BlocProvider<RecordsBloc>(create: (_) => getIt<RecordsBloc>()..add(const RecordsStarted()))`, replacing the
258	  direct `RecordsPlaceholderPage()` builder. `records_placeholder_page.dart` is deleted.
259	- `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s registration gains `sessionRepository:
260	  getIt<SessionRepository>()`; one new `getIt.registerFactory<RecordsBloc>(...)`.

# Data Model: P-RF07 — Multi-source history (timeline)

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1 (RF07), 6.2, 8, 13; `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`;
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` (list) and `/entries/{id}` schemas;
`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §§2.4, 3, 6. This unit extends the `entries` feature's shared
`Entry`/`EntriesRepository` (RF01) with two new read methods, and adds one new feature folder's worth of
domain helpers and presentation (`records/`, R8) — it introduces no new backend-shaped entity beyond widening
one existing enum (R2).

## `Entry` (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`) — extended, not replaced

Every field RF01 already modeled (`id`, `content`, `source`, `chatMessageId`, `occurredAt`, `tags`,
`piiStatus`, `piiSpans`, `embeddingStatus`, `mediaDurationSeconds`, `serverRevision`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`)
is unchanged in shape — this unit reads `serverRevision`/`updatedAt` (sync-badge.md's two fields) and `tags`
(read-only chips), which RF01 already carries but never renders. One change:

```dart
enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }   // chat added (research.md R2)
```

## `EntriesPage` (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entries_page.dart`) — NEW

The shape of one `GET /entries` response, minus the fields this unit never uses (`meta.total`, and every
`source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` filter parameter — reserved for RF06).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `entries` | `List<Entry>` | `data`, in the order the backend returns it (newest-occurred-first, per the resolved ordering Clarification). |
| `nextCursor` | `String?` | `meta.nextCursor` verbatim; `null` means this was the last page. |

```dart
class EntriesPage extends Equatable {
  const EntriesPage({required this.entries, required this.nextCursor});
  final List<Entry> entries;
  final String? nextCursor;
}
```

## `EntriesRepository` — extended (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source}); // unchanged (RF01)
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;                                                                   // unchanged (RF01)
  Future<Either<Failure, EntriesPage>> list({String? cursor});                                      // NEW
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> getById(String id);                                                // NEW
}
```

- **`list`** → `GET /entries` (`entries-list`), query parameters `cursor` (when non-null) only — no `limit`
  override (backend default 20), no `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` (filters are RF06's).
- **`getById`** → `GET /entries/:id` (`entries-get`), `pathSegments: [id]`. Implemented and tested; no call
  site in this unit's UI flow (research.md R7).
- Both retry exactly once through `SessionRepository.refresh()` on `AuthExpiredFailure` before giving up
  (research.md R4) — see `contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` for the exact sequence. `create()` is
  untouched.

### `EntriesRemoteDataSource` — extended (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_remote_data_source.dart`)

Adds `list({String? cursor})` and `getById(String id)`, both parsing responses through the *same* private
`_parseEntry` the existing `create()` already uses (made reusable across a single object and a list of
objects) — no duplicated parsing logic. `list()` additionally parses `meta.nextCursor`.

### `EntriesRepositoryImpl` — extended (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart`)

Gains one new constructor dependency: `SessionRepository` (`session/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`
— a cross-feature *domain* interface, the same shape `SessionRepositoryImpl` already depends on `auth`'s
`Account`). `cachedEntries`/`create()` behavior is unchanged.

## `ApiClient` — extended (`lib/core/network/api_client.dart`)

```dart
Future<Either<Failure, Map<String, dynamic>>> call(
  String function, {
  required String method,
  Map<String, dynamic>? body,
  List<String>? pathSegments,
  Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,   // NEW (research.md R1)
  AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession,
})
```

`queryParameters` is passed straight through to `Dio.request()`. Every existing call site (`entries-create`,
`auth-session`, `auth-refresh`, `media-ocr`) is unaffected — the parameter defaults to omitted.

## `SyncBadgeState` / `LocalWriteOutcome` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart`) — NEW

```dart
enum SyncBadgeState { synchronized, synchronizing, error }
enum LocalWriteOutcome { pending, failed }

class SyncBadge {
  const SyncBadge._();
  static SyncBadgeState derive(LocalWriteOutcome? localWrite) => switch (localWrite) {
    null => SyncBadgeState.synchronized,
    LocalWriteOutcome.pending => SyncBadgeState.synchronizing,
    LocalWriteOutcome.failed => SyncBadgeState.error,
  };
}
```

A pure, total function over `sync-badge.md`'s model (research.md R6). `RecordsBloc` calls it with
`localWrite: null` for every entry it ever renders — both of its entry sources (`EntriesRepository.list()`'s
results, `.cachedEntries`) are, by construction, already server-confirmed. Never depends on session/auth state
(FR-005), by having no session-related input at all.

**Mapping to the prototype's sync badge** (`prototype-extract.md` §3/§6 — reuses existing `DesignTokens`
verbatim, no new token):

| `SyncBadgeState` | Dot color | Label |
|---|---|---|
| `synchronized` | `DesignTokens.colorSuccess` (`#4C6B4F`) | "sincronizado" |
| `synchronizing` | `DesignTokens.colorWarningSync` (`#C98A3E`) | "sincronizando" |
| `error` | `DesignTokens.colorError` (`#B3402A`) | "erro de sync" |

## `DateGroup` / `DateGrouper` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/date_group.dart`) — NEW

Maps spec.md's "Entry Timeline Page" grouping requirement (FR-002) to a pure function, independent of widget
code so it's directly unit-testable (RNF07).

```dart
class DateGroup extends Equatable {
  const DateGroup({required this.label, required this.entries});
  final String label;            // "Hoje" | "Ontem" | "{day} de {monthName}" (research.md R9)
  final List<Entry> entries;     // newest-to-oldest by occurredAt (resolved ordering Clarification)
}

class DateGrouper {
  const DateGrouper._();
  static List<DateGroup> group(List<Entry> entries, {DateTime? now});
}
```

- Input `entries` is assumed already sorted newest-to-oldest (see `EntryMerger` below, which guarantees this
  for `RecordsBloc`'s own data) — `group()` only buckets, it never re-sorts within or across groups.
  Groups themselves come out newest-to-oldest because the input is.
- Bucketing compares each entry's `occurredAt.toLocal()` calendar day against `(now ?? DateTime.now()).toLocal()`'s —
  the device's local calendar day (spec.md Assumptions), not UTC.
- `now` is an optional override purely for deterministic unit tests ("today" fixed at a known instant); production call sites omit it.

## `EntryMerger` (`lib/features/records/domain/entities/entry_merger.dart`) — NEW

Implements spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 (dedupe-by-ID, preferring the fresher copy).

```dart
class EntryMerger {
  const EntryMerger._();
  static List<Entry> merge({required List<Entry> primary, required List<Entry> secondary}) {
    // union by id, primary's copy wins on a shared id, result sorted newest-to-oldest by occurredAt
  }
}
```

`RecordsBloc` calls `EntryMerger.merge(primary: <freshly fetched or already-displayed entries>, secondary:
entriesRepository.cachedEntries)` every time it has a new batch to show (research.md R3) — never inside
`EntriesRepositoryImpl`.

## `RecordsEvent` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_event.dart`) — NEW

| Event | When |
|---|---|
| `RecordsStarted` | `RecordsPage.initState` — triggers the first page fetch. |
| `NextPageRequested` | The list's `ScrollController` crosses a near-bottom threshold, and `!hasReachedEnd && !isLoadingMore`. |
| `PageLoadRetried` | The user taps "Tentar novamente" on a failed first load (`RecordsLoadFailure`) or a failed further-page load (`RecordsLoaded.pageLoadFailure`). |
| `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` | `RecordsPage`, once the insertion-modal `showModalBottomSheet` future resolves (research.md R10) — re-merges `cachedEntries` into the currently displayed list, no network call. |

## `RecordsState` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_state.dart`) — NEW

Maps spec.md's "Entry Timeline Page" key entity directly to this sealed state's `RecordsLoaded` fields
(entries fetched so far + the cursor to continue from) — no separate domain class for it (research.md-style
reasonable decision: nothing else needs this shape outside the bloc that owns it).

```dart
sealed class RecordsState {}

class RecordsLoading extends RecordsState {}

class RecordsLoadFailure extends RecordsState {
  const RecordsLoadFailure(this.failure);
  final Failure failure;   // any failure type, including AuthExpiredFailure (research.md — see below)
}

class RecordsLoaded extends RecordsState {
  const RecordsLoaded({
    required this.entries,        // merged + deduped, newest-to-oldest
    required this.nextCursor,
    required this.isLoadingMore,
    this.pageLoadFailure,         // a further-page fetch failed; entries above stay intact, retryable
  });
  final List<Entry> entries;
  final String? nextCursor;
  final bool isLoadingMore;
  final Failure? pageLoadFailure;

  bool get hasReachedEnd => nextCursor == null;
  bool get isEmpty => entries.isEmpty;   // RecordsPage renders "Vazio" for this, never a separate event
}
```

- **First-load failure, any cause (including `AuthExpiredFailure`)** → `RecordsLoadFailure` — never the empty
  state, so a true zero-entries account is never confused with "couldn't load" (research.md's reasoning under
  R5/R7). The one-shot `reauthRequired` stream (next section) still fires in the `AuthExpiredFailure` case, on
  top of this state — the overlay appears over the retryable error screen.
- **Further-page failure, `AuthExpiredFailure`** → `entries`/`nextCursor` are left exactly as they were,
  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false` (so the next scroll-near-bottom re-attempts the same, unconsumed cursor);
  `pageLoadFailure` is **not** set for this case — only the one-shot stream fires. This is what makes FR-007's
  "without discarding the entries already loaded or the current scroll position... restored exactly as it
  was" true by construction (nothing in `RecordsState` changed).
- **Further-page failure, any other cause** (timeout, offline, validation, ...) → `pageLoadFailure` set,
  `isLoadingMore` resets to `false`, entries unchanged — a retryable inline banner at the bottom of the list
  (FR-009/Edge Cases).

## `RecordsBloc` (`lib/features/records/presentation/bloc/records_bloc.dart`) — NEW

```dart
class RecordsBloc extends Bloc<RecordsEvent, RecordsState> {
  RecordsBloc({required EntriesRepository entriesRepository});

  Stream<void> get reauthRequired;   // one-shot (research.md R5) — fired on a post-retry AuthExpiredFailure
}
```

Depends only on `EntriesRepository` (never `SessionRepository`, never `ConnectivityChecker` — research.md
R4/R11) — the one domain-layer dependency this bloc needs. Never imports `SessionBloc` or any of its
event/state types (requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion).

## Widgets (`lib/features/records/presentation/widgets/`, `pages/records_page.dart`) — NEW

Not separately contracted (pure prototype-fidelity rendering, no new state/logic beyond what's above):

- `records_page.dart` — `Scaffold` with the prototype's header (back arrow, title, inert download icon —
  FR-008), inert search bar + funnel button (FR-008), a `ListView` driven by `RecordsLoaded.entries` grouped
  through `DateGrouper`, a `ScrollController` that survives `BlocBuilder` rebuilds (never recreated, so scroll
  position is never lost — FR-003/FR-007), and the `reauthRequired` subscription (research.md R5).
- `record_card.dart` — one entry: spine + icon colored by `source` (table below), monospace time
  (`occurredAt.toLocal()`, `HH:mm`), `SyncBadgeDot` (table above), text excerpt (`content`, no truncation logic
  beyond what the card's fixed layout naturally clips), tag chips (`EntryTag.name`, only when `tags.isNotEmpty`
  — FR-002/Acceptance Scenario 2).
- `records_empty_state.dart` — notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", "Criar primeiro registro" button
  calling the shared `openInsertionModal()` (research.md R10).
- `sync_badge_dot.dart` — the 8px dot + mono label pair, parameterized by `SyncBadgeState`.

**Origin marker mapping** (`prototype-extract.md`'s `sourceMeta`, verbatim hex — reuses existing `DesignTokens`,
no new color token; Phosphor icon names mapped to this app's existing Material-icon convention, same mapping
style RF01/RF02 already used for their own icons):

| `EntrySource` | Spine/icon color | Material icon (Phosphor equivalent) |
|---|---|---|
| `manual` | `DesignTokens.colorPrimary` (`#1F3D34`) | `Icons.edit_outlined` (`ph-pencil-simple`) |
| `audio` | `DesignTokens.colorSecondary` (`#7C8B6F`) | `Icons.mic_none` (`ph-microphone`) |
| `photo` | `DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary` (`#6B6255`) | `Icons.image_outlined` (`ph-image`) |
| `chat` | `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (`#C98A3E`) | `Icons.chat_bubble_outline` (`ph-chat-circle-text`) |

## Routing / DI changes

- `lib/core/routing/app_router.dart`: `AppRoutes.records`'s builder wraps `RecordsPage` in
  `BlocProvider<RecordsBloc>(create: (_) => getIt<RecordsBloc>()..add(const RecordsStarted()))`, replacing the
  direct `RecordsPlaceholderPage()` builder. `records_placeholder_page.dart` is deleted.
- `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s registration gains `sessionRepository:
  getIt<SessionRepository>()`; one new `getIt.registerFactory<RecordsBloc>(...)`.

How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's four user stories. A run guide —
interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in `data-model.md`.

- A second, brand-new test account with zero entries, for Story 2.
- Enough entries (more than one backend page — the default page size is 20) to exercise pagination for
  Story 1's Acceptance Scenario 3.

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint

lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html    # RNF07 gate — now covering entry_merger.dart,
                                                         # date_group.dart, sync_badge_state.dart, plus
                                                         # EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()/getById()
dart test/architecture/no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart   # requirements.md RF07's own acceptance criterion
```

`contracts/entries-repository-extension.md` and `contracts/records-bloc.md` each carry the full scenario
table this unit's coverage depends on.

## Manual verification (device/Simulator)

### Story 1 — Seeing every entry in one place, regardless of origin (P1)

1. Open the side menu (☰) → "Meus Registros" from Home/Chat. **Expect**: records grouped under "Hoje" /
   "Ontem" / explicit older dates (newest group first), each card showing the right spine color + icon for
   its origin (manual = dark green/pencil, audio = olive green/mic, photo = gray/image, chat =
   ochre/chat-bubble), a time, a sync badge, a text excerpt, and tag chips only on entries that actually have
   tags.
2. Confirm the seeded `chat`-origin entry renders like any other card (ochre spine, chat-bubble icon) — no
   crash, no "unrecognized" placeholder.
3. Scroll to the bottom. **Expect**: further entries load and append automatically, with no "load more"
   button, no disturbance to the cards already on screen, and no visible scroll jump.
4. Scroll to the true end of history. **Expect**: loading simply stops — no error banner, no "end of list"
   message.

### Story 2 — Starting from nothing (P1)

1. Sign in on the zero-entries account, open "Meus Registros". **Expect**: the notebook icon, "Nenhum
   registro ainda", and the "Criar primeiro registro" button — never a blank or perpetually-loading screen.
2. Tap "Criar primeiro registro". **Expect**: the same Insertion Modal RF01/RF02 already built opens over
   this screen.
3. Save a text entry. **Expect**: the modal closes back onto "Meus Registros" (not Home/Chat), and the new
   entry now appears in its correct date group ("Hoje"), replacing the empty state.

### Story 3 — The session expires while browsing (P2)

1. Load "Meus Registros" with several entries visible, scroll to a specific, identifiable position.
2. Force the next `GET /entries` call to return `AUTH_EXPIRED` (e.g., via a debug toggle/expired test token)
   and either scroll further or wait for a background refresh attempt to trigger it. **Expect**: the "Sessão
   expirada" overlay appears over the screen; the entries and scroll position underneath are completely
   unchanged (confirm by dismissing-and-checking before re-authenticating, if your test harness allows it).
3. Tap "Entrar novamente" and re-authenticate successfully. **Expect**: the overlay dismisses; the screen is
   exactly as it was (same entries, same scroll position) — no reload, no reordering.
4. Scroll further again. **Expect**: pagination now resumes normally (the next page is fetched successfully
   with the fresh session).

1. With entries visible, force a silent session renewal in the background (a renewable `AUTH_EXPIRED` the
   refresh call recovers from transparently). **Expect**: no visible change to any card — no badge flicker,
   no overlay, no reload (silent renewal never surfaces to the UI).
2. Repeat Story 3's forced-expiry-and-overlay flow. **Expect**: once the overlay is dismissed, every badge on
   every card underneath shows exactly the same state (color + label) it showed before the overlay appeared.
3. Since every entry this unit can display is already server-confirmed by construction (research.md R6),
   every badge observed in steps 1–2 should read "sincronizado" (green) — this is expected, not a bug; it is
   not possible to observe "sincronizando"/"erro de sync" through this unit's own flows alone (spec.md
   Assumptions).

### Edge cases worth exercising manually at least once

- Turn on airplane mode after the first page has loaded, then scroll to trigger another page. **Expect**: a
  clear, retryable inline error at the bottom of the list; the entries already shown stay visible and
  scrollable; no write of any kind is attempted.
- Turn airplane mode back on, tap the retry affordance from that error. **Expect**: it fails again cleanly
  (no crash); turn airplane mode off and retry again. **Expect**: pagination resumes normally.
- Force the very first `GET /entries` call (on screen open) to fail outright (not just offline). **Expect**:
  a full-screen retryable error — never the "Nenhum registro ainda" empty state.
- Tap the header's download icon and the search bar/funnel button. **Expect**: both render exactly per the
  prototype but do nothing (FR-008 — inert placeholders; no export, no filter sheet, no search).
- With a known seeded account (more than one page of entries where the newest page happens to be empty, e.g.
  nothing created "today" or "yesterday" but older entries exist), open "Meus Registros". **Expect**: paging
  continues directly to the older groups — the empty state must **not** appear.

# Implementation Plan: P-RF06 — Semantic search / filter

**Branch**: `006-semantic-search-filter` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; none of this repo's
extension hooks are configured, per spec.md's own header)

**Date**: 2026-10-17 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/006-semantic-search-filter/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
§1 (RF06), §6.4 (`GET /entries/search`), §6.2 (`GET /entries`), §8, §9, §10 (300 ms debounce), §13;
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/entries/search` schemas; `docs/input/backend/fixtures/
seeded-search-entries.md`; `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.4 ("Tela 4 — Meus Registros", "Sheet
de filtro", "Filtros ativos"); and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on RF07
(`specs/005-multi-source-timeline/`), already implemented — this is the unit that makes RF07's own inert
search bar and funnel button on "Meus Registros" actually do something.

## Summary

"Meus Registros" gains a live semantic search bar (`GET /entries/search`'s `q`, 300 ms debounced) and a filter
sheet (date-range + entry-type, mapped to `GET /entries`'/`GET /entries/search`'s shared `dateFrom`/`dateTo`/
`source` parameters), both narrowing the same `RecordsLoaded` list RF07 already renders. No new screen, no new
bloc: the already-built `RecordsBloc` is extended in place with five new events (`SearchTextChanged`,
`FilterSheetApplied`, `FilterChipRemoved`, `FiltersAndSearchCleared`, and an internal `SearchDebounceElapsed`)
and three new `RecordsLoaded` fields (the currently-applied `searchQuery`/`dateRange`/`entryTypes`), because
the two things RF06 must guarantee — "a new action supersedes any in-flight earlier one" (FR-005a) and "AND
across axes, OR within the entry-type axis" (FR-005) — both need a single, already-serialized owner of
"what the current criteria is and which fetch is the latest one," which is exactly what one bloc already is.
`EntriesRepository.list()` gains optional `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`/`limit` parameters (additive, RF07's own
cursor-pagination callers unaffected) and gains a new `search()` method (`GET /entries/search`, bounded,
no cursor — FR-005b). Multi-select entry types (`source` is single-valued; FR-003/FR-005's resolved
Clarification) fan out one repository call per selected type and merge+dedupe+re-sort the results with a new
`EntryMerger.mergeMany()` — the same dedupe-by-ID idea RF07's `EntryMerger.merge()` already implements,
extended to N equal-weight sources instead of a primary/secondary pair. The one genuinely new domain concept
this unit introduces is `DateRangeOption` (a pure, testable date-range → `dateFrom`/`dateTo` mapping) and
`ActiveFilterChip` (a pure derivation of which removable chips the screen shows) — both total functions with
zero I/O, directly unit-testable like every other `records/domain/` helper RF07 already shipped.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
F000/RF01/RF02/RF03/RF07.

**Primary Dependencies**: No additions. Reuses the full existing stack — `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`,
`equatable`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`), `go_router`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. The 300 ms debounce is
implemented with a plain `dart:async` `Timer` inside `RecordsBloc` (the same primitive
`login_signup_page.dart` already uses for its own 300 ms RNF01 loading-indicator delay) — research.md R4
explicitly rejects adding `rxdart`/`bloc_concurrency` for this, since a single `Timer` + a monotonic
generation counter already gives both the debounce and the request-supersession guarantee FR-002/FR-005a need.

**Storage**: No new persistence. "Offline shows cached results" (FR-010/User Story 4) falls out of the
existing pattern RF07's `_fetchNextPage` failure branch already established — a failed fetch never clears

# Research: P-RF06 — Semantic search / filter

Phase 0 output. Each item below is a reasonable technical decision made under Constitution Principle I
("where these documents are silent, implementers MUST make a reasonable technical decision rather than block
on clarification") — none reopens a spec.md Clarification; each extends one by filling in a mechanical detail
the Clarification's own wording left open.

## R1 — Does a multi-select entry-type, no-query (filter-only) combination keep RF07's cursor pagination?

**Decision**: No. Whenever more than one entry-type chip is selected, the result set — whether or not a
search term is also active — is a bounded, one-shot merge of one request per selected type (each capped at
`limit: 50`), exactly like FR-005b already mandates for an active search term. `NextPageRequested` becomes a
no-op in this case (`hasReachedEnd` reads `true` because the bloc stores `nextCursor: null` for any bounded
fetch). RF07's real cursor-based infinite scroll (`GET /entries`'s `cursor`/`meta.nextCursor`) continues to
work exactly as before only when **zero or one** entry-type chip is selected and no search term is active.

**Rationale**: spec.md's Clarification 1 resolves *how* multi-type selection is combined ("one request per
selected entry type... merges... de-duplicates... re-sorts... before rendering") but is silent on whether that
merged set itself keeps paginating. Clarification 2 resolves the search-active case explicitly ("no `cursor`
parameter... the single fetch... is the complete result set") and explicitly names `GET /entries`'s *existing*
cursor-based scroll as what resumes for "filter-only or unfiltered browsing" — singular, i.e. the one-call-one-
cursor shape RF07 already built. Reproducing a correct merge-sorted infinite scroll across N independently-
paginated per-type cursor streams (keeping every stream's cursor, re-merging on every page, handling one
stream reaching its end before another) is a materially different and more complex mechanism that neither
the spec nor the prototype describes or tests for. Treating "2+ types selected" as bounded — the same shape
already resolved for search — is the smaller, already-proven extension; a real account is unlikely to need
more than 50 of a given type merged before adjusting filters further.

**Alternatives considered**: (a) maintaining N parallel cursors and merge-sorting every further page — rejected
as unspecified complexity with no test material backing it; (b) silently capping multi-type selection to the
first type only — rejected as a visible product regression from the prototype's own multi-select affordance,
which Clarification 1 explicitly preserves.

## R2 — How are `DateRangeOption`'s `dateFrom`/`dateTo` bounds computed?

**Decision**:
```dart
enum DateRangeOption { allTime, thisWeek, thisMonth }
```
- `allTime` → `(from: null, to: null)` — no parameter sent.
- `thisWeek` → `from` = the most recent Monday at local 00:00:00, `to` = `null`.
- `thisMonth` → `from` = the 1st of the current local calendar month at local 00:00:00, `to` = `null`.

Both non-`null` bounds are converted with `.toUtc().toIso8601String()` before being sent as `dateFrom`
(matching the `date-time` format every other date field in `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml` already
uses, and the same `DateTime.parse`/`.toLocal()` round-trip `entries_remote_data_source.dart`/`record_card.dart`
already establish for `occurredAt`).

**Rationale**: the prototype only names the three options ("Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês") without
defining their exact boundaries — this is squarely "where these documents are silent." Leaving `dateTo` open
(`null`, meaning "through now") is simpler and avoids an off-by-one risk at the exact current instant; nothing
created in the future exists to accidentally include. The function takes `now` as a parameter
(`boundsAt(DateTime now)`), mirroring RF07's `DateGrouper.group(..., {DateTime? now})` precedent, purely so
tests can fix "today" deterministically.

**Alternatives considered**: `thisWeek` as "the last rolling 7 days" instead of "since Monday" — rejected
because a calendar-week boundary reads more naturally against the prototype's Portuguese label ("Esta semana")
and matches how `DateGrouper` already buckets by calendar day, not by a rolling window.

## R3 — Why does `Entry` gain a nullable `similarity` field instead of a parallel "search result" entity?

**Decision**: add one nullable field, `final double? similarity`, to the existing `Entry` entity (defaults to
`null`; only `entries_remote_data_source.dart`'s parsing for the `entries-search` response ever sets it to a
non-null value). `EntriesRepository.search()` returns `List<Entry>`, the same type `list()`'s page already
carries — not a new `SearchResultEntry` wrapper type.

**Rationale**: spec.md's own Key Entities section defines "Search Result Entry" as "**a Journal Entry (as
already defined by RF07)**... ordered by relevance" — explicitly the same entity, not a new one. The only
thing `GET /entries/search`'s response adds over `GET /entries`'s is one extra, optional field
(`similarity`, 0–1), needed solely to re-sort a multi-type merge by relevance (R1). Every other field in the
`entries-search` response schema is identical to `entries-list`/`entries-create`'s. Modeling it as a sibling
optional field keeps `record_card.dart` and every other `Entry` consumer unchanged (nothing reads
`similarity` outside `EntryMerger.mergeMany()`'s relevance-sort branch) and keeps `EntryMerger.mergeMany()`
able to merge `list()`'s and `search()`'s results through one shared type, which per-type fan-out (R1) needs
when some types are fetched via `list()` and others — never, actually, since a given fetch round is either
all-`list()` or all-`search()` depending on whether a query is active, but a single shared return type still
avoids two near-identical merge functions.

**Alternatives considered**: a parallel `SearchResultEntry extends Entry { final double similarity; }` —
rejected: it would need its own `mergeMany` overload (or a cast back to `Entry` anyway to interoperate with
`DateGrouper`/`RecordCard`, which expect `List<Entry>`), without buying any type safety spec.md's own wording
asks for.

## R4 — Why no new dependency for the 300 ms debounce?

**Decision**: a single `dart:async` `Timer`, owned by `RecordsBloc`, reset on every `SearchTextChanged` event;
when it fires, it calls `add(const SearchDebounceElapsed(text))` to re-enter the bloc's own event loop. The
`Timer`'s `Duration` is an injectable constructor parameter (default `Duration(milliseconds: 300)`) so tests
can pass `Duration.zero`.

**Rationale**: this is the exact mechanism `login_signup_page.dart` already uses for its own 300 ms RNF01
delay (`_loadingIndicatorTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), ...)`) — an established,
zero-dependency pattern in this codebase. `flutter_bloc`'s built-in `EventTransformer` mechanism (e.g. a
`debounce()` transformer from `bloc_concurrency`/`stream_transform`) would do the same job but requires adding
a package neither RF07 nor any earlier unit needed (Principle II favors the fixed, already-adopted stack; a
one-field `Timer` is simpler than a new transitive dependency for one call site).

**Alternatives considered**: `bloc_concurrency`'s `restartable()`/`debounceTime` combinator — rejected, new
dependency for no behavioral gain over a `Timer`; a widget-level `Timer` inside `RecordsPage` instead of inside
`RecordsBloc` — rejected because the bloc, not the widget, is what also owns the generation counter (R6) and
the currently-applied criteria fields; splitting debounce-timing into the widget and supersession-tracking
into the bloc would spread one cohesive concern across two files for no benefit.

## R5 — What happens to `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` once search/filter criteria exist?

**Decision**: `RecordsLocalCacheRefreshed` (fired by `RecordsPage` once the insertion-modal's
`showModalBottomSheet` future resolves, re-merging `EntriesRepository.cachedEntries` — RF07's own mechanism)
becomes a no-op whenever any search/filter criteria is currently active (`isSearchActive ||
hasActiveFilters`). When no criteria is active, it behaves exactly as RF07 built it.

**Rationale**: `cachedEntries` holds every locally-created entry regardless of its `source`/`occurredAt` —
RF07 could merge it in unconditionally because nothing on that screen ever filtered. Under an active search
term or filter, a just-created entry might not satisfy the current criteria (wrong `source`, outside the
chosen date range, or — for an active search term — a semantic match nothing on-device can evaluate), so
merging it in unconditionally would violate FR-005's AND-across-axes guarantee by showing an entry that
doesn't actually match. Skipping the merge while criteria are active is the smaller, correctness-preserving
choice; the next explicit criteria change (or clearing filters) naturally re-fetches and would include it if
it matches.

**Alternatives considered**: re-running the full criteria fetch instead of a local-only merge whenever the
modal closes with an active criteria — rejected as an extra network call for an edge case (creating an entry
from "Meus Registros" while already mid-search) spec.md's own User Stories never describe as a flow to
support; the no-op keeps behavior correct without inventing new traffic.

## R6 — Request-supersession mechanics for FR-005a

**Decision**: a single private `int _fetchGeneration = 0` field on `RecordsBloc`. Every fetch-initiating
method (`_loadFirstPage`, `_fetchNextPage`, the new `_fetchForCriteria`) does
`final generation = ++_fetchGeneration;` *before* its `await`, and checks `if (generation !=
_fetchGeneration) return;` immediately *after* the `await`, before calling `emit(...)`. Any event that starts
a new fetch (a debounce firing, a filter applied, a chip removed, "Limpar filtros", a next-page request, a
retry) bumps the counter, so a slower, now-superseded earlier call's result is silently discarded exactly
once it resolves.

**Rationale**: spec.md's Clarification 3 states this requirement in exactly these terms ("only the most
recently fired request... is ever authoritative... discarding the response of any earlier, now-superseded
request"). A monotonic counter checked before every `emit` is the simplest mechanism that satisfies this for
every trigger listed (debounce fire, filter change, chip removal, clear) without needing per-request

selected entry type... merges... de-duplicates... re-sorts... before rendering") but is silent on whether that
merged set itself keeps paginating. Clarification 2 resolves the search-active case explicitly ("no `cursor`
parameter... the single fetch... is the complete result set") and explicitly names `GET /entries`'s *existing*
cursor-based scroll as what resumes for "filter-only or unfiltered browsing" — singular, i.e. the one-call-one-

paginated per-type cursor streams (keeping every stream's cursor, re-merging on every page, handling one

the spec nor the prototype describes or tests for. Treating "2+ types selected" as bounded — the same shape
already resolved for search — is the smaller, already-proven extension; a real account is unlikely to need
more than 50 of a given type merged before adjusting filters further.

| 7 | Tap a chip's remove control | dispatches `FilterChipRemoved` with that exact chip value |
| 8 | Tap "Limpar filtros" | dispatches `FiltersAndSearchCleared` |
| 9 | `isEmptyForCriteria == true` | `NoResultsForCriteriaView` renders, not `RecordsEmptyState` |
| 10 | Type into the search bar | `SearchTextChanged` dispatched once per keystroke (debounce coalescing verified in `records-bloc-extension.md`'s own tests, not here) |

# Quickstart: P-RF06 — Semantic search / filter

How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's four user stories. A run guide —
interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in `data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- RF07 (`specs/005-multi-source-timeline/`) already implemented and passing — "Meus Registros" already
  renders a timeline with a (previously inert) search bar and funnel button.
- The three fixtures in `docs/input/backend/fixtures/seeded-search-entries.md` seeded on the signed-in test
  account, none containing the literal search terms `ansiedade`/`cansaço`/`gratidão`.
- An account with entries spanning multiple `source` values (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`) and multiple
  calendar dates/weeks/months, to exercise the entry-type and date-range filters together.
- A second scenario: an account with entries, where a search/filter combination is known to match zero of
  them (e.g., a date range before any entry's `occurredAt`), to exercise FR-009.

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint
fvm flutter test --coverage
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html    # RNF07 gate — now covering date_range_filter.dart,
                                                         # active_filter_chip.dart, EntryMerger.mergeMany(),
                                                         # plus EntriesRepositoryImpl.search()
dart test/architecture/no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart   # RF07's own acceptance criterion — unaffected by this unit
```

`contracts/entries-repository-search-extension.md`, `contracts/records-bloc-extension.md`, and
`contracts/filter-sheet-widget.md` each carry the full scenario table this unit's coverage depends on.

## Manual verification (device/Simulator)

### Story 1 — Finding an entry by what it means, not what it says (P1)

1. Open "Meus Registros", type `ansiedade` into the search bar. **Expect**: exactly one network call fires
   300 ms after the last keystroke (watch the debug `LogInterceptor` output — no request per keystroke), and
   the seeded "racing thoughts before a presentation" entry appears even though it never contains the word
   "ansiedade".
2. Repeat with `cansaço` and `gratidão` against their respective seeded entries (SC-001).
3. Clear the search text completely (backspace to empty). **Expect**: no new search request is sent for the
   empty string; the list immediately returns to showing whatever filters are still active (or the full list,
   if none).
4. Type a few characters, then delete them all again before pausing. **Expect**: no request is ever sent for
   the abandoned partial text (Edge Cases).

### Story 2 — Narrowing the list with filters (P1)

1. Tap the funnel button. **Expect**: the filter sheet opens with "INTERVALO DE DATA"
   (Todo o período/Esta semana/Este mês), "CATEGORIA" (trabalho/rotina/descanso/relações), and
   "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (manual/áudio/foto/chat) groups, matching the prototype.
2. Select "Esta semana" + "áudio" + "foto", tap "Aplicar". **Expect**: the sheet closes; the list narrows to
   entries from the current week that are either audio- or photo-sourced (AND between date range and the
   type set; OR within the type set — SC-003).
3. Re-open the sheet, select a "CATEGORIA" chip (e.g., "trabalho"), tap "Aplicar". **Expect**: the result list
   is completely unaffected by that selection (Acceptance Scenario 2).
4. Re-open the sheet, select several chips, tap "Limpar" (inside the sheet, not "Limpar filtros"). **Expect**:
   every chip inside the sheet visually deselects; the sheet stays open and the screen's actual applied
   filters are unchanged until "Aplicar" is tapped.

### Story 3 — Seeing and clearing what's currently applied (P2)

1. With the Story 2 filters applied, look under the search bar. **Expect**: a removable chip for "Esta
   semana", a removable chip for "áudio", a removable chip for "foto", a "Limpar filtros" link, and the
   funnel button rendered in its filled/active style (SC-004).
2. Tap the "foto" chip's remove control. **Expect**: only that criterion drops — the list now shows audio
   entries from this week only; the screen does not reload or lose scroll position.
3. Tap "Limpar filtros". **Expect**: every chip disappears, the funnel button returns to its neutral style,
   any active search text is also cleared, and the screen shows the same full, unfiltered list RF07 already
   renders — without navigating away (SC-005).
4. With a search term active (no filters), confirm no chip appears for the search term itself — only the
   Filter Set (date range/entry types) gets chips; "Limpar filtros" still clears the search text too.

### Story 4 — Cached results stay trustworthy through a connectivity blip (P3)

1. Apply a search term or filter, confirm results load, then enable airplane mode.
2. Scroll within the already-loaded results. **Expect**: they remain visible and scrollable from memory; no
   blank/error screen appears just from toggling connectivity.
3. Trigger a refetch while offline (e.g., change a filter chip). **Expect**: a clear, retryable inline error
   appears; the previously-shown entries stay on screen (never discarded).

- `data-model.md` — extends `Entry`, `EntriesRepository`, `EntryMerger`; introduces `DateRangeOption` and `ActiveFilterChip` as pure domain entities; extends `RecordsEvent`/`RecordsState`/`RecordsBloc`.

- `contracts/records-bloc-extension.md` — full handler-by-handler bloc extension (debounce, bounded-vs-paginated fetch branching, generation guard, filter chip removal, clear).
- `contracts/filter-sheet-widget.md` — the filter sheet, active-filter-chips row, and funnel/search-bar UI wiring.
- `quickstart.md` — manual + automated validation scenarios mapped to the spec's 4 user stories.

**Key design decisions**: no new bloc, no new feature folder, no new dependency — RF07's existing `RecordsBloc` and `EntriesRepository` are extended in place, reusing established patterns (the `Timer`-based delay from `login_signup_page.dart`, RF07's `EntryMerger`/silent-refresh-retry).
